title: Fifth and Lavaca: utility work ahead
subtitle: City-posted sequence · durations approximate
alt: City-posted construction sequence: starting the week of October 12, Fifth Street has one lane from9 a.m. to 4 p.m. daily for about six weeks; afterward Lavaca has two lanes for about four weeks, with around-the-clock work. No exact second-phase start date confirmed.
